headline: Rivers United Announce New Sponsorship Deal With Goka Sports
seoTitle: NPFL Postpones Sporting Lagos vs Rivers United Match
metaDescription: Rivers United have finalised a three-year shirt sponsorship agreement worth N490m with Goka Sports and Casino to bolster the club's financial standing.
aiSummaryBullets: Rivers United signed a three-year sponsorship contract with Goka Sports and Casino.
The partnership is valued at approximately N490m, or $350,000.
The agreement designates Goka Sports and Casino as the club's front-of-shirt sponsor.
aiContextParagraph: Rivers United, based in Port Harcourt, have officially entered into a three-year commercial partnership with Goka Sports and Casino. This sponsorship deal is valued at $350,000, which translates to approximately N490 million. The agreement positions the betting and sports brand as the primary front-of-shirt sponsor for the football club. This financial arrangement arrives as the team continues to compete in the Nigeria Premier Football League, following their second-place finish in the league standings during the previous season. The announcement of the sponsorship comes in the wake of scheduling disruptions for the club, including an indefinite postponement of their match against Sporting Lagos. The club intends to leverage this commercial support as they maintain their pursuit of the league title and continue their professional operations within the national football circuit.
whyItIsViral: The story is gaining traction following coverage from two independent news outlets reporting on the financial development for the Port Harcourt-based football club.
